text: 企查查APP显示，近日，上海保润利华企业发展有限公司成立，法定代表人为吴劲松，注册资本约为45亿元，经营范围包含：物业管理；工程管理服务；市政设施管理；停车场服务；非居住房地产租赁；房地产开发经营等。企查查股权穿透显示，该公司由华润置地控股有限公司旗下上海泓喆房地产开发有限公司、保利发展全资子公司上海保利城市发展有限公司共同持股。（人民财讯）
text_en: Qichacha APP shows Shanghai Baorun Lihua Enterprise Development Co., Ltd. was recently established, with legal representative Wu Jinsong and registered capital of about 4.5 billion yuan, covering property management, engineering management services, municipal facility management, parking services, leasing of non-residential real estate, and real estate development. Qichacha equity data shows the company is jointly held by Shanghai Hongzhe Real Estate Development under China Resources Land Holdings and Shanghai Poly City Development, a wholly owned subsidiary of Poly Developments. (People's Financial News)
